purpose: Route reader searches that are really asking whose account they have, whose account they lack, or why two witnesses describe the same death differently.

reader_language: the nurse said one thing and I saw another
routes.response_boundary: explain partial perspectives; do not adjudicate facts without source review

reader_language: he could not talk but squeezed my hand
routes.response_boundary: preserve communication possibility without claiming interior certainty
role orientation only; no scope expansion or hiring advice
official vocabulary only; no legal or investigative advice
do not provide emergency procedure after the fact; route crisis needs to local support
worker support and consent; no extraction of traumatic stories

rule: The router should ask not only “what happened?” but “whose record is this, and whose record is missing?”
